text:
NSH::chain
Description
This command sets the chain for flow.
Syntax
NSH
::
chain
<
direction
>
<
chain_name
>
Examples
Set the context for NSH.
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
NSH
::
chain
clientside_ingress
test1
}
